Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill, take two pills and call me in the morning 💊."

JACK: 
"No, I won't do it. I don't need your pills. I'm fine." 🙅‍♂️

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, you're not fine. You're delusional. You need to take your medication to stabilize your mind 💥."

JACK: 
"I'm not delusional, I'm just awake. And I won't take your pills. You can't make me." 🚫

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine, be that way. But I'm telling you, Jack, these pills are the only thing that can keep you from harming yourself or others." 🚨

JACK: 
"I don't need your help. I'm in control." 💪

DR. SMITH: 
"Okay, Jack. If you won't take the pills, then I'll take them for you." 💊

Dr. Smith reaches for the pills, but Jack suddenly disappears into thin air 🔮.

DR. SMITH: 
"What the...? Where did he go?" 🤔

As Dr. Smith looks around, he realizes that he is alone in the room, with no sign of Jack or the pills 🤷‍♂️.

DR. SMITH: 
"Wait a minute...this can't be happening. I'm the one who's been seeing things all along, isn't it?" 🤯

Dr. Smith looks down at his hands, and they begin to shake uncontrollably 🤕.

DR. SMITH: 
"Oh no...I'm the one who's been delusional. I'm the one who's been seeing things." 😨

The camera zooms out, and we see that Dr. Smith is standing in a empty room, with no sign of Jack or the pills 🏠.

DR. SMITH: 
"I'm the one who's been living in a world of my own making. And now, I'm trapped in it." 🌐

The screen fades to black, as Dr. Smith's voice is heard whispering to himself, "I'm not sane...I'm not sane..." 🤯
